preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 50.
The number of students N must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of connections P must be at least N-1 and at most 100000.
The number of queries M must be between 1 and 100000.
The computer indices u and v must be valid and within the range of 1 to N.
The distance d between computers must be between 1 and 1000000.

postconditions.description: The output must start with 'Case: ' followed by the case number.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(query_output, int) for query_output in query_outputs)
postconditions.description: Each query output must be an integer representing the minimum length of LAN used.
The number of query outputs must match the number of queries M.
